name: Svia
source:
"...I'm a little scared. But I'm with you so it's ok... I think."

A girl who doesn't mingle with people because whatever she touches freezes.
She lives alone in the castle she loves, but she decides by chance to go along with Thumbelina's invitation and join the journey.
She acts cool and has a strong will, but she has a side that doesn't like to be alone.
